name: Singapore NEWater membrane reclamation
description: Singapore’s PUB and environment ministry demonstrated a treatment train at Bedok that turned treated municipal wastewater into high-grade reclaimed water using microfiltration, reverse osmosis and ultraviolet disinfection. The programme supplies industrial users and supplements drinking water indirectly through reservoir blending and treatment at waterworks.

date.label: May 2000
date.basis: Singapore’s project team and PUB timeline date commissioning to May.

events.statement: The NEWater demonstration plant at Bedok began producing reclaimed water using microfiltration, aromatic polyamide thin-film composite reverse osmosis and ultraviolet disinfection.

evidence.supports: Gives the treatment stages, membrane material and commissioning month.
The expert panel report identifies the installed membrane type and the treatment train.
Confirms the opening month and location of the prototype.

date.basis: PUB and the project team agree on the year. The PUB timeline dates official openings to January, and the project team dates the formal launch of potable and industrial use to February.

events.statement: The first full-production NEWater facilities officially opened at Bedok and Kranji.

evidence.supports: Dates the official openings of both factories.
Reports that the first full-production facilities went online in early 2003 and names separate January plant and February public launch milestones.

date.label: 21 February 2003
date.basis: The project team gives the first date of flow to the reservoirs.

events.statement: NEWater began flowing to Bedok and Kranji surface-water reservoirs, entering Singapore’s indirect potable supply route.

evidence.supports: Dates first flow into the Bedok and Kranji surface-water reservoirs.
Explains the route through reservoir blending and further treatment at waterworks.

date.label: 31 July 2009
date.basis: Sembcorp’s Monday 3 August 2009 release places the start on the preceding Friday.

events.statement: Changi NEWater Factory 1 started first-phase commercial operations, delivering reclaimed water to PUB.

evidence.supports: Reports commencement of first-phase operations and delivery.
Separately dates the formal opening of Changi 1.

date.label: 31 July 2024
date.basis: PUB confirms the retirement date for the Bedok factory.

events.statement: Bedok NEWater Factory closed. Singapore continued producing NEWater at other plants.

evidence.supports: Confirms the closing date of the Bedok factory.

evidence.locator: p. 13, Development of Changi NEWater Factory 3
evidence.supports: Distinguishes Bedok from the four existing factories at Kranji, Ulu Pandan and Changi.

earliest_record.rationale: The demonstration plant is the earliest verified operating instance of this NEWater treatment programme.

links.statement: The Bedok demonstration used Hydranautics aromatic polyamide thin-film composite RO elements, in the same broad design family as the aromatic polyamide composite documented for Cadotte.

evidence.locator: p. 44, treatment description; p. 46, Major Suppliers
evidence.supports: Lists Hydranautics as supplier of the reverse-osmosis units and specifies the aromatic polyamide composite membrane type.
Records the type of RO membrane installed at the demonstration.
Establishes the broad supported thin-film aromatic polyamide design.

unresolved.note: The Bedok demonstration element model and any specific transfer or licensing route from Cadotte’s design remain unverified.
